display_long_description:
# Join our Discord.
Super City is in Early Access, so there’s a lot of new content coming soon. Tell us what you’d like us to add next! https://discord.gg/tqPj7xvdRP

[media]

# Become a supervillain.
Play as a biological experiment released by the nefarious Dr. Suffer to wreak havoc across the city. Fly around the city using superpowers to do anything you want - see the sights, race your friends, destroy the world!

# Tons of powers.
Pick any superpower you want! There’s currently 31 unique superpowers in the game, with more being added constantly.

[media]

# Create havoc, get rich.
Use your powers to smash any object in the city, from cars and pedestrians to ginormous bosses threatening to be even evilier than you!

# Upgrade your powers.
Spend your hard earned cash to upgrade your powers. Each power has a unique upgrade tree, pick different paths to customize your build!

[media]

# Team up with friends.
Hang out with your friends, race each other with superpowers, or team up to fight giant bosses. Show everyone all your cool cosmetics!
